name: Alchemy
desc: Higher alchemy skill allows you to learn higher level alchemy recipes.  Alchemy recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

ranks.name: Apprentice
ranks.desc: Allows an alchemist to brew basic potions up to a maximum potential skill of 75. Requires Herbs found with the Herbalism skill.

ranks.name: Journeyman
ranks.desc: Allows an alchemist to brew standard potions up to a maximum potential skill of 150.

ranks.name: Expert
ranks.desc: Allows an alchemist to brew amazing potions up to a maximum potential skill of 225.

ranks.name: Artisan
ranks.desc: Allows an alchemist to brew astounding potions up to a maximum potential skill of 300.

learnedFrom.name: Recipe: Elixir of Detect Lesser Invisibility
